model.name: selfHeal.recomputeDerivedOnRead
model.description: MODEL self-heal on READ (C4.1, symmetric read-side of the C4 controller): every unit READ recomputes its DERIVED fields to reality (fresh) or REFUSES (throws, fail-loud) — never returns a silently-drifted value (C2/C6: stored status 'Planned' while checklist advanced). GENERIC: a per-ior healer REGISTERS (mirrors registerPolicy), ScenarioIndex.get invokes it on every read, a class with no healer is accepted as-is (a new class gains self-heal-on-read by registration ONLY, zero mechanism edits). Task = healer #1 (recompute status from checklist via deriveStatusEnum).
